description.text: General Information Courses are divided by foundational, intermediate and advanced classes. Students who successfully completed the study will be conferred relative certificates of University of Jinan. Courses Provided •Required Courses: Basic Chinese, Listening Comprehension, Conversation, Reading, Composition, etc. •Selective Courses: Professional Chinese, Ancient Chinese Language, Contemporary Chinese, Chinese Classics, Philosophy, History of Chinese Culture, Chinese Calligraphy, Martial Arts, Chinese Traditional Handcraft, etc. • Lessons can also be determined according to specific needs of the students. Teaching Arrangements • Students will study 3 hours every day from Monday to Friday. • Term trips will be arranged to relative historical and cultural sites. Characteristic and Advantage Student tutors (majoring in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language) will be arranged to help language learners with their Chinese language study. duration.text: The One Year Chinese Language Program at Weifang University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1. The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3. Applicants must Be in good health
